subject.title: [Bug]: TTS elevenlabs provider generates audio but OpenClaw plays OpenAI voice instead

question: Should Auto-TTS keep using other configured speech providers as fallbacks when the selected provider is skipped or fails, or should OpenClaw expose or enable provider stickiness for configured providers?
rationale: Current docs and tests make fallback deliberate, but this report shows the fallback can surprise users and obscure provider billing/voice expectations; automation should not choose that product policy.

options.title: Add opt-in provider stickiness
options.body: Keep fallback as the compatibility default, but expose a documented strict mode that fails visibly instead of playing another provider when the selected provider cannot be used.

options.title: Keep fallback-only behavior
options.body: Treat the remaining behavior as expected after diagnostics and docs clearly explain why OpenAI may play.

options.title: Fail closed by default
options.body: Make configured providers sticky by default and require upgrade communication because existing fallback setups may stop producing audio.

recommendation.title: Add opt-in provider stickiness
recommendation.body: Keep fallback as the compatibility default, but expose a documented strict mode that fails visibly instead of playing another provider when the selected provider cannot be used.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current-main ownership signal on the central speech-core fallback loop, and the remaining question is cross-cutting fallback policy.
